_comment: Audio manifest for Scape. Pre-audio-engine. This file enumerates every music cue, ambient loop, SFX, and vocal sting the game will ever need. Every SFX has a `trigger` that corresponds to a game event type; validate-audio-triggers.js confirms all triggers are declared in conventions.known_events. Vocal stings draw from NPCs that exist in data/npc-bibles.json.

vocal_stings.line: You're new. State your business at the wall.
Right. Take this. Bring it back, or someone else will bring me word about you.
I trust you with a real one now. Don't be a fool about it.
Mind the south road.
Mind the cinder. What do you need.
Right. Come back when the bell rings noon. Not before.
Sit. Watch this heat. This one's yours.
Mind the cinder.
The chapel is open. So am I.
Walk safe, then.
Fair prices today. Fair for me, anyway.
That'll do. Next.
The water watches you. Decide what it sees.
You asked. Now you know. The cost is the same either way.
Pain? Name it, not where it hurts.
Fresh this morning. Don't ask about yesterday.
Harbour's open. Mind the tide bell.
Positions. Now.
If you run, run together. If you can't, run fast.
Hearth's lit. Take the stool nobody likes.
If you're buyin', I'm listenin'. Loudly.
Strings cost the same as arrows. People forget that.
You brought me gems or a question. I'll price either.
Soot's in your lungs already. Welcome to working.
The steel says you're ready. That's rarer than the rank.
Line's moving. Be in it or be out of it.
If it shouldn't work, that's when I like it.
Down the ladder, little forge. Down.
The desert remembers. Walk as though you do too.
[roar] — crystalline discord, choral swell
[high-pitched hum, facets cracking]
You came up from the valley to die in a hall. How quaint.
Enough pretence. Come see what I actually am.
A worthy ending. Remember me.
Breathe in. That's it. That's me.
Low again. Good. Hits harder like that.
Look into me. Choose the face you deserve.
Now the mirror chooses.
Every forge I sit atop. Every breath you take is mine.
Hush, hush. Mother is tasting.
Little one. The web is listening.
Sing with me. Or be sung about.
Rest — and now — attack.
At last. Someone who climbed this far. I won't waste it.
Good. Now the second answer.
You were the answer.
I am what's left.
Feed the world instead of me.
[deep rumble] — the final flight takes notice.
[low exhale, like wind through a bellows]
The desert named a child once. It remembers the name.
The mirage chooses now.
Answer me a small thing truly and you may pass.
Form up. Not one step back.
Wilderness task. Watch your back — not mine.
Forty gargoyles. The cave you already know.
You did that cleaner than the master does.
Buy? Sell? Or story? Only one is free.
Your secret has a price. So does mine.
One wins. The rest remember.
Target acquired. Don't make it interesting.
Hold the portals. Nothing else matters.
You overcooked the last one. Try harder.
Don't touch anything I didn't touch first.
The balance holds. Keep it that way.
Root, stone, breath. The grove walks with you.
Draw weight's right. Not showy, right.
Don't read what isn't written. Don't remember what isn't yours.
All hands. Hands that aren't are out.
We fight as one. You fight two.
Sun withdraws. Moon answers.
Warm hands, warm words. Short visit, though.
Bird sees what you miss. Trust it once.
A page exists somewhere I have not read. I am well.
The price is the price. My smile costs extra.
Hear that? That's it almost working.
The canopy counts visitors. Be a number it forgets.
You came back. Don't get used to it.
